scope: The sole primary member is the complete retained ThML document. Preserve its complete header and document-shell inventory, all six ordered top-level div1 roots, every supported body descendant, and explicit colgroup/col presentation dispositions.
body_policy: Every supported body element is projected once in source order to standard TEI. Exact direct text, child order, source IDs, mapped attributes, and tails are checked independently. Source div titles may produce a source-derived TEI head when no matching direct heading exists.
attribute_policy: Every source element attribute is recorded exactly in source-accountability.json. Readable attributes are mapped to TEI where supported; navigation attributes and presentation-only column declarations remain source-accountability evidence.
shell_policy: Record the XML declaration, external DOCTYPE identifiers, prolog/epilog nodes, processing instructions, comments, and complete ThML.head element inventory. The external DTD is never fetched.
metadata_policy: Preserve provider-record title, creator, publisher, created date, language, subjects, description, source and rights fields as source observations. Do not infer the print edition, original publication date, translator, rights clearance, or canonical constituent-part boundary.
